title: Estimate a Poisson rate
description: You connect the count mean with its information estimate and likelihood plot.

steps.description: You sample 150 Poisson counts with rate 2.3. y stores the simulated observations.

steps.question: Which statistic becomes the rate estimate?
steps.answer: lam_hat is y.mean(), the sample mean count. The recording reports 2.413.

steps.description: You form observed information m/lam_hat and pass it to wald_ci. The recorded standard error is about 0.1268 and the interval is (2.165,2.662).
You score candidate rates with y.sum()*log(lambda)-m*lambda. The plot marks the fitted and true rates on that likelihood curve.
